title: Tabs
api:
interface TabsProps {
  items: Array<{ value: string; label: string; content: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }>
  defaultValue?: string
  value?: string
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void
  className?: string
  'aria-label'?: string
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
  orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'
  /** Arrow keys move focus; Enter/Space activates by default. */
  activateOnFocus?: boolean
  loopFocus?: boolean
}

function Tabs({
  items,
  defaultValue,
  value,
  onValueChange,
  className,
  size = 'md',
  orientation = 'horizontal',
  activateOnFocus = false,
  loopFocus = true,
  'aria-label': ariaLabelProp,
}: TabsProps);

props.name: items
props.type: Array<{ value: string; label: string; content: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }>

props.name: activateOnFocus
props.description: Arrow keys move focus; Enter/Space activates by default.

notes: Tabs uses items with value, label and content; do not invent TabsList/TabTrigger exports.
Default activateOnFocus=false: arrows move focus; Enter/Space selects. Use tabs for views inside a page, ordinary links for navigation.
